answer: Drones fly a spiral over an ocean plume and share a relay. During one common test window, receivers sign the raw bytes they actually receive for each unique receiver-bound nonce. The scheduler consumes each receipt once and assigns priority by bytes, without account bonuses. A hundred aliases on one 10 Mbps bottleneck still share 10 Mbps. More priority needs real extra capacity, which agents can rent. Tests cost bandwidth and rely on honest receivers.
